# Game Nuke Official

> Official information source for Game Nuke Premium, an Android gaming performance utility.

Canonical website: https://gamenukeofficial.com/
Primary language: Indonesian
Current release: v2.6.0-prem
Supported platform: Android 11–16, ARM64
Core access model: no root required for core features; selected execution modes may use Shizuku/iAdb on compatible devices.

## What Game Nuke is
Game Nuke groups Android gaming utilities into one performance cockpit. The official website describes telemetry, thermal monitoring, memory utilities, network/DNS tools, display controls, Shizuku-compatible execution modes, and a floating gaming cockpit.

## Official distribution
- Web Edition: https://gamenukeofficial.com/
- Google Play Edition: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.neon.gametweak

## Important product context
Game Nuke is an independent Android utility project. The website states that the app operates at the Android system layer and is not designed to modify game installation files.
